ops.text: False. The tap was judged again 30 s later and became a land order: cci 531256 (id lr.tap/#530986, lane tap-orders) at 1:30:05 AM PT, 30 s after the two 1:29:35 'no review row yet' warnings in ~/.local/state/lr-mac-landing/landing.log. Main already holds the order cursor on prrow.ErrRowsNotFolded until the tap is an hour old (internal/facts/orders.go:61-66), and TestATapBeforeTheFirstRowsAreFoldedWaitsAndIsOrderedOnceTheyAre covers tap first, fold after, order written. What held #50886: its last gate, finder ok (cci 531659), landed at 1:40:52, about 30 s after landing pass 2 (started ~1:37:18) finished its 3m02s read. Pass 2 ran to 1:45:33 (8m14s total) without it; pass 3 (~1:46:03 to 1:52:39, 6m36s) queued #50886 at 1:52:39. The 1:45 hand order (531799) was redundant. Two real gaps: (1) WriteOrders logs every failed attempt at warn and nothing when the order is written, so landing.log shows a warning with no resolution, which is what edit-as-fork read as never retried; (2) a landing pass takes 4m42s to 8m14s over ~200 PRs (read 3m02s-4m19s, act up to 3m38s), so a gate landing mid-pass waits up to two passes, about 12 min here.
